title: Top Things To Do In Pasadena: July 16th through 22nd - NewsBreak
text:
Courtesy Pasadena Heritage Pasadena Heritage Bridge Party
Pasadena Heritage is once again transforming the iconic Colorado Street Bridge into the setting for a festive evening of live music, food, vintage cars, kids’ activities, and community celebration—all while closing the bridge to traffic. The Bridge Party honors the organization’s long‑standing efforts to preserve Pasadena’s historic landmarks, offering attendees a memorable and meaningful night under the stars.
Buy Tickets International Gem and Jewelry Show
Discover a treasure trove of jewelry, gems, and accessories at the International Gem and Jewelry Show. Encounter direct shopping experiences with designers and industry insiders.
Buy Tickets California Care Convention
Pasadena is hosting its inaugural California Care Convention at the Convention Center—a free, all‑ages wellness event featuring local health‑focused exhibitors, expert panels, door prizes, and community networking. Aiming to foster connections among adults and seniors, the daylong gathering highlights modern wellness trends and encourages active engagement with healthcare resources.
Buy Tickets 100 Years - 100 Images
The 100 Years – 100 Images exhibition at the Pasadena Museum of History showcases a century of art from the Pasadena Society of Artists. This dual exhibition intertwines historical masterpieces with contemporary works, celebrating its Centennial Anniversary. From founding artists to modern talents, experience a vibrant blend of past and present artistry.
Learn More Jazz in the Park
Miro Sprague Trio
Jazz in the Park is a free concert series held on Sunday evenings at Playhouse Village Park, featuring various jazz bands. Attendees can bring picnic dinners and enjoy the performances on the lawn. The concert on July 6th is Kira & the Major 3.
